summary: Generated 30 ordered Story 18.4 tasks across shared setup, four independently testable user stories and final verification; every accepted R/I/S/A/F/L/T decision ID is cited on a task checklist line, with behavioral RED and production GREEN assigned to separate owners.

self_review.intent_and_coverage: US1 covers real operator/target authority, atomic setup and Story 18.1 approval adaptation; US2 covers exact two-host selection; US3 covers scoped context and provider profiles; US4 covers ordinary startup and sanitized outcomes. FR-001 through FR-012 and SC-001 through SC-006 remain represented by the story tests, qualification and accepted plan.
self_review.source_seams: Tasks use the existing PreparedSourceApproval, PreparedSourceGrantRequest, mandatory IPreparedSourceCurrentAuthorityVerifier, PreparedSourceContextIssuer, borrowed IPreparedSourceReadContext and exactly three PreparedSourceFunctions. No second source identity/tool contract, physical-path model argument or later Worker dispatcher is requested.
self_review.data_model: Tasks carry the batch state, one database per batch, one immutable opaque root binding per (BatchId, RepositoryId), exact approval tuple, short expiry/revocation, context provenance/conflict and no durable live context/path/continuation constraints.
self_review.ownership_and_order: Each changed behavior slice names a test owner RED before a separate production owner GREEN; project scaffolding and resource qualification use proportionate direct checks. Dependencies serialize shared Program.cs, setup store, suite inventory and PostgreSQL runner work.
self_review.resource_boundary: T020 and T029 require root-established explicitly authorized owned PostgreSQL/certificate/Identity targets and runner cleanup. No other story's database, credentials or provider access is assumed.
self_review.scope: The minimal generator is limited to prepare/select. JDT-LS, CodeGraph, Scan/Worker dispatch, paid provider execution, Knowledge generation/publication/reads and Chat remain outside.
self_review.project_lesson_precaution: The completed Story 18.1 public-seam lesson is met by tasks against accepted callable issuer, verifier, Web route and selector shapes. PostgreSQL tasks use new owned targets and explicit migration-history placement; hash-bound artifacts retain their existing EOL policy.

checks.speckit_setup_tasks: FEATURE_DIR matched specs/017-october-batch-setup; TASKS_TEMPLATE_CONTENT and AVAILABLE_DOCS were consumed from the selected PowerShell adapter.
checks.task_format: 30 sequential T001-T030 checklist lines passed; all user-story phase lines have [US1]-[US4], and every task has an explicit path.
checks.plan_task_design_content: Installed validate_plan_implementation_design(plan, tasks, require_explicit=True) returned no errors; all accepted R/I/S/A/F/L/T IDs are covered and no X/C ID is cited as implementation work.
checks.whitespace: Direct whitespace scan passed; these new files are untracked, so the root must run git diff --cached --check after staging.
checks.hooks: No before_tasks or after_tasks hook is registered in the readable .specify/extensions.yml.
